summary_en: Upper limit: ¥500M, 580,000 shares (2.80% of shares outstanding). Market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange. Execution window: 22 July 2026 to 31 March 2027.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Asahi Printing announced on 21 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The buyback will acquire up to 580,000 shares (2.80% of shares outstanding, calculated as 580,000 ÷ 20,684,065 ex-treasury shares) for a maximum outlay of ¥500 million. The shares will be acquired via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 22 July 2026 and 31 March 2027. The stated rationale is to execute flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the business environment, enhance capital efficiency, and enrich shareholder returns. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 2,206,764 treasury shares against 20,684,065 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
